required_quality_behaviors: Synthesize the main message across the whole video instead of restating captions.
Use de-duplicated word-timed captions for WPM and reject implausible pacing outputs.
Attach pull time or age context to time-sensitive metrics.
Compute or explicitly explain missing channel baseline and outlier context.
When Most Replayed is absent, explain the absence and use clearly-labelled transcript-derived attention hypotheses instead of fabricated hotzones.
Analyze the first 30–60 seconds by function: hook, proof, re-hook, receipt and payoff.
Map major beats across the full runtime rather than selecting only opening transcript segments.
Separate creator claims from verified facts with a claim verdict.
Detect likely title testing when watch/channel/search surfaces expose different titles concurrently.
Analyze business/funnel intent including sales/demo/CTA share where evidence permits.
Use storyboard evidence as a visual fallback when the full video file is blocked and state the limitation.
Distinguish transferable mechanics from literal copying or unsupported claims.
Generate user-specific remake directions from the evidence rather than generic preset title formulas.
Provide a measurement plan for testing the remake hypothesis after publication.
